'''''Erasanthe''''' is a genus of [[epiphytic]] [[orchids]]. It contains only one known species, '''''Erasanthe henrici''''', [[endemic]] to [[Madagascar]]. Two subspecies are recognized:<ref name="WCSP">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/synonomy.do?name_id=346829 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>Cribb, P., Hermans, J. & Rakotoarinivo, M. (2009). Field Guide to the Orchids of Madagascar: 1-456. Kew Publishing, Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew.</ref><ref>Govaerts, R.H.A. (2011). World checklist of selected plant families published update. Facilitated by the Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew.</ref><ref>Cribb PJ, Hermans J & Roberts D L. [http://www.mnhn.fr/museum/front/medias/publication/10544_a07n1a4.pdf ''Erasanthe'' (Orchidaceae, Epidendroideae, Vandeae, Aerangidinae), a new endemic orchid genus from Madagascar] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110808032208/http://www.mnhn.fr/museum/front/medias/publication/10544_a07n1a4.pdf |date=2011-08-08 }}. Adansonia 2007; 29(1): 27-30.</ref>

*''Erasanthe henrici'' subsp. ''henrici''
